bullets.F1: Added a runtime OPcache script cache for dynamic `include` and `require` through `eval()`, with optional persistent file caching, timestamp revalidation, admission limits, blacklists, preloading, live statistics, and API restrictions; ordinary compiled code remains ahead of time and no tracing JIT is provided.
bullets.F2: Added project INI directives in the `[ini]` table of `elephc.toml`, using the same settings as `--ini` and allowing command-line overrides.
bullets.F3: Improved scalar code generation by promoting eligible `int`, `bool`, and `float` locals into SSA values across branches and loops, and refining effects for resolved static calls.
bullets.X1: Fixed serialization and unserialization of PHP classes that forbid it, with catchable exceptions, and omitted uninitialized typed properties from serialized property counts.
bullets.X2: Fixed `implode()` and `join()` on nullable, mixed, and runtime-promoted arrays, preserving actual element layouts, catchable type errors, and safe integer formatting near the string scratch-buffer limit.
bullets.X3: Fixed ownership of callable and reference entries in associative `array_chunk()` results, bound closures on Linux x86_64, and strings stored in static properties.
bullets.X4: Fixed `PDOException` subclass validation and reflected method ownership, isolated driver connection diagnostics per thread, and preserved SQLSRV constructor SQLSTATE and native error codes.
bullets.X5: Fixed qualified predefined names, named `::class` constants in defaults and attribute keys, nested array spread types, interface reflection order, strict-PHP callable guards, runtime `boolval()` callables, and the exception class and messages for invalid mixed throws.
bullets.X6: Fixed deeply nested compiler entry points, unreachable EIR continuations, reference-return callable metadata, and dynamic include/eval handling of templates, argument counts, scoped returns, and pending exceptions across `finally`.
bullets.F4: Added EIR integer range and induction-variable analysis to remove proven-safe overflow checks and simplify boxed numeric values while preserving PHP overflow-to-float behavior.
bullets.X7: Improved diagnostics for unparenthesized `instanceof` call targets, missing class-constant names, disabled `class_alias()` autoload, and conflicting include-variant signatures.
bullets.X8: Fixed source identities for literal eval fragments so type and binding metadata cannot collide with equal coordinates in root or included files.
bullets.X9: Fixed heap leaks when eval writes back replacements through native typed by-reference variadic parameters.
bullets.X10: Fixed constant propagation and control-flow handling across switch fallthrough, side-effecting case labels, and default blocks that appear before later cases.
bullets.X11: Fixed `urlencode()` and `rawurlencode()` to leave ASCII digits unescaped.
bullets.X12: Fixed crashes when reading untyped null properties from `get_object_vars()` or an object-to-array cast.
bullets.F5: Added compile-time generics for functions, classes, interfaces, methods, and traits, with inference, bounds, defaults, variance, typed arrays and callables, and PHPDoc template support; `--strict-php` accepts PHPDoc templates and rejects native generic syntax.
bullets.X13: Fixed sparse array writes, typed-to-mixed array argument ownership, bare-array value builtins, mapped result types, `array_map(null, ...)`, associative filtering and sorting, internal-pointer values, and callable string-transform leaks.
bullets.X14: Fixed descriptor wrapper placement to keep generated functions contiguous, avoiding AArch64 branch-range assembly failures and broken ELF function extents under `--debug-info`.
bullets.X15: Fixed argument-unpack validation to reject positional entries after named entries within the same unpacked array.
